files.description: tokenTotalSupplyByPeriod(period, PHAR / xPHAR) of the gauge at END for every period overlapping the window

Swaps of the deepest PHAR pool quoted in WAVAX or USDC: the Solidly-style (constant-product, stable=false) PHAR/WAVAX pair 0x0afdee8162ccead9ac6a30c94f691e6e7d1af670. token0 = PHAR (18 dp), token1 = WAVAX (18 dp). amount0/amount1 = amountIn - amountOut. reserve0/reserve1 = the Sync emitted just before the Swap in the same transaction (post-swap reserves). DERIVED columns (the pair has no v3 state): sqrt_price_x96 = floor(sqrt(reserve1 * 2^192 / reserve0)), liquidity = floor(sqrt(reserve0 * reserve1)), tick = getTickAtSqrtRatio(sqrt_price_x96). fee_ppm = pair fee from the legacy factory's SetPairFee events (denominator 1e6), anchored on pair.fee() at START.

limitations: The keyless tenderly gateway stopped serving (HTTP 429, daily egress allowance used up) after it had delivered pool logs for blocks 91716610..99816609; blocks 99816610..99924388 of the pool were served by publicnode in both passes and were therefore compared record by record with the Routescan logs API instead (checks.re_requests.pool_range_served_by_publicnode_in_both_passes).

Gauge, feed, PHAR pools and legacy factory logs were served once, by publicnode; they were not pulled a second time in full. Five random ranges of each were compared with Routescan, the feed's round ids are consecutive, and the gauge's per-period sums equal the contract state.

The gauge period that contains START (2952, began 2026-07-30) was notified before the window: its NotifyReward is not in pharaoh_gauge_notify.csv.gz; its amount is in gauge_periods.json (state read at END).

phar_pool_swaps.csv.gz is a constant-product pair: sqrt_price_x96, liquidity and tick are derived from the event reserves, not event fields. The deepest PHAR pool overall (PHAR/p33) was not pulled because p33 has no USD reference.
PHAR/USD is not stored: PHAR is quoted in WAVAX in both PHAR files; convert with feed_avax_usd or the AVAX/USDT klines.
No Pharaoh documentation URL was consulted for the reward form; the statement rests on contract reads and events only.
Facts marked from_repo_doc_not_re_verified were read from the repository's own source-reference document, not re-derived here.
